goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Sektorenwandel, atypische Beschäftigung und Digitalisierung analysieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Three equally dignified working arrangements illustrate hands-on work, services and work from different locations. The central question compares activities, time/place and collaboration without asserting a deterministic replacement of industrial work or claiming every remote job is atypical employment.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px workshop, service discussion and remote collaboration are distinguishable, with the central thinking person and comparison icons clear.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px actor roles and time/place/collaboration considerations can be read without numerical trend claims.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The mechanic team faces its component and tools; the remote worker faces the actual laptop screen, with notebook lying normally. The service discussion has a correctly placed generic paper.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The selected forms are illustrative. Atypical employment concerns contractual arrangements and is not proven by remote location alone; the reviewed text must make that distinction.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
